These host grammars are test fixtures, excluded from the VSIX. YAML comes from
VS Code 1.139.1 (MIT), originally RedCMD/YAML-Syntax-Highlighter; the upstream
source URL and revision are retained in each JSON. CUE comes from
cuelangorg.vscode-cue 0.0.21 (MIT); its license is CUE-LICENSE.txt.

The compact ingest.yaml fixture is representative syntax from tmdb-embed's
Redpanda Connect config. Core tests do not depend on other checkouts.
